regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your prayer and for your kind favor just noted. Thank God, while i have been "half down" for several weeks, still its nothing possitively serious. Of course we are hoping it will clear up so that I be able to do a little more toward so much waiting to be done. Thank the Lord too: I am glad things seems brightening up for you and yours. It always comes right if only we have a little trustful confidence in the good God and our Blessed Mother Mary Immaculate.
